StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is exactly what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). StackType's only non-presentation readers are GetTypeForAmount (PowerModel.cs:462) and InvokePowerModified's VFX split (Creature.cs:628). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterSideTurnStart.issue: LIVE. The player leg is one slot too early. The sim's on_player_turn_start (player.py:169) fires BEFORE the hand draw (player.py:171-186), where C#'s AfterSideTurnStart is dispatched at CombatManager.cs:522, AFTER SetupPlayerTurn (:514) has reset energy and drawn the hand. The sim's matching post-draw slot is on_player_turn_started (player.py:186). EXECUTED: a spy listener records [on_player_turn_start hand=5, 4x on_card_drawn, on_player_turn_started hand=9]. Third-file citations, not hashed here. EXECUTED co-occurrence witness with two ported Ironclad cards: Hellraiser (cards/hellraiser.py:36) auto-plays every Strike as it is DRAWN, and Demon Form (cards/demon_form_card.py:35) grants Strength at turn start. On the turn after Demon Form 2 is played, the sim grants the Strength first and the auto-played Strikes take it with them -- enemy HP 41 -> 17 -- where the game draws (and auto-plays) first and only then grants Strength, leaving those Strikes un-Strengthened at 41 -> 23. Six damage the game never deals. The enemy leg (powers.py:221-224) has the separate per-creature problem recorded in its own guard entry.

guards.issue: Enemy leg: the sim uses the per-creature on_enemy_turn_start (combat.py:301), which runs immediately before THIS enemy's move, where Hook.AfterSideTurnStart runs once at CombatManager.cs:522 before ANY enemy moves. Worse than the AfterSideTurnEnd family, because the sim has no enemy-side-START slot at all to move it to -- that absence is turn_structure gap G5's other half. Per rule 3 the same verdict, cross-referenced. Observable with two or more enemies: an enemy holding Demon Form gains its Strength after earlier enemies have already acted in the sim, and before all of them in the game. Reproduce the population with `py tools/audit/power_census.py slots`. Third-file citations, not hashed here.
